notes: Summary: Crestline builds a cloud contact center platform used by several mid-size telcos and OTTs. Looking to add low-latency streaming agent assist (token-level suggestions + canned reply tool-calls) to reduce AHT and ramp time.
Customer quote (VP Eng): "We need sub-100ms suggestion latency for 90% of typing interactions — anything above that the agents don’t use."
Primary constraints: strict EU data residency for a subset of customers, SSO via SAML, must demonstrate audit logs and KMS integration.
Current stack: Genesys/Avaya front-end via CTI bridge + homegrown orchestration; willing to run Redwood Dedicated or Private in their VPC.

POC ask: streaming suggestions with guardrails (intent detection + blocklist), live tool-calls to CRM and ticketing (create/update ticket), and graceful degradation under sudden spikes (Black Friday test scenario).

Notes from demo 2026-03-02: Redwood streaming looks promising; engineering wants model fallback to smaller quantized models during spikes; prefetched prefixes for common flows could save 20-30% tokens — need config guidance (Optimize).
Security: asked for SOC2 type II report, encryption-in-transit + at-rest, and HSM/KMS key rotation details. Sent security FAQ link 2026-03-04.
Legal: redlines on data residency & log retention. Legal wants proof MSA supports EU-only storage for EU tenant data.
Sales pitch takeaways: emphasize Dedicated autoscaling/burst and rollout canaries + tracing per agent session.
